{"notes": "VISIT 2 (4:00). Status: both body lines and the bottom tail are now connected (dark) and run from the nose around to about x=27.5. The top body line ends near x=25.7, y=6.4, where Maya's hands are. The top tail (x 22.7-27.7) is still pale and unconnected, and the body end doesn't line up with it. About 6 minutes left, so this is the one thing left to fix. I still don't know who placed which piece, so I'm not crediting anyone for specific dominoes.

Maya: Spoke up this time and was the sharpest observer. She checked the top tail closely, found it pale, and correctly diagnosed the misalignment. She offered to redo it from the pad and took it on when Priya handed it over. Her hands are at the open end, which backs that up. Strong ownership and collaboration, and she is quietly becoming the team's problem-solver. Check whether the redo connects.

Tom: Said the fish was nearly there and stayed off Priya's join to avoid overlap. He planned to re-check the tail after the connect. Reliable and coordinated, but this visit he added little beyond status. His earlier clear voice and ownership still stand.

Priya: Delegated well this time. She admitted her connect can't make the turn, handed the top tail to Maya, and promised a full check from the nose. That is a real improvement on the muddled start. Leadership is improving, but her own join didn't fix the top tail. See whether the final check happens.

Leo: Silent again and no hands shown. I have no new evidence on him. Ask him directly on the next visit what he did, and don't rate him on guesswork."}
